description: This file provides synchronous access functions for interacting with OVSDB, including JSON-RPC communication, database backup, and transaction handling.

methods.name: ovsdb_sync_write_fn
methods.description: Callback for json_dump_callback() to write data to OVSDB socket.

methods.name: exec_cmd
methods.description: Executes a shell command and logs the result.

methods.name: is_ovsdb_changed
methods.description: Determines if the OVSDB transaction data indicates a change.

methods.name: ovsdb_backup
methods.description: Performs a backup of the OVSDB database with synchronization.

methods.name: ovsdb_write_s
methods.description: Performs a synchronous write to OVSDB, handling connection, sending JSON, and reading response.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_method_send_s
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC method call synchronously to OVSDB and returns the result.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_tran_call_s
methods.description: Performs a synchronous transaction call to OVSDB.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_insert_with_parent_s
methods.description: Inserts a row with a parent relation into OVSDB synchronously.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_delete_with_parent_res_s
methods.description: Deletes rows with a parent relation from OVSDB synchronously.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_delete_with_parent_s
methods.description: Wrapper for deleting rows with parent relation from OVSDB synchronously.
